title: Slash FAQ
description: A 64px serif heading with a grey line ending in an underlined link on the left, and on the right a list of 24px questions divided by hairlines with thin chevrons; a question slides open its answer and flips its chevron, one at a time. Stacked on phones with 16px questions.
notes: needs JavaScript for the accordion (hydrate); static HTML shows the questions closed
